course.title: Manufacturing Process - I
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value:
A solid cylindrical slug made of 304 stainless steel is 150 mm in diameter and 100 mm 15   
high. It is reduced in height by 50% at room temperature, by open die-forging with flat   
dies. Assuming that the co-efficient of friction is 0.2 and the absolute value of the true   
strain is 0.69; calculate the forging force at the end of the stroke.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2017
